Hi, I'm Vanya

 

I enjoy starting with a blank canvas and turning it into something that works. Whether I’m shaping an interface, writing the code, or both, I create web and mobile experiences that are thoughtful, useful, and pleasant to use.

Let's connect:

I bring ideas from “what if?” to “here it is.”

a little about me

// hi!
vanya.2026front-end dev

I don't think I ever really chose design. I've just always been drawn to it, from colours and interiors to the little details that make things feel right. As a kid, I spent hours on our PC using MS Paint and MS Publisher to make posters and play with layouts.

That curiosity eventually led me to software engineering, where I found a way to bring design and code together. Now, I enjoy creating thoughtful web and mobile experiences that feel simple, intentional, and human.

PAW — Productivity & Wellness

Mobile Application
FLUTTERDARTFIREBASEFIRESTORE

A productivity and wellness app for students, bringing academic tools and personal wellbeing into one place — tasks, a Pomodoro timer, AI flashcards, study rooms, mood & sleep tracking, meal logging, and guided relaxation, with role-based access enforced via Firebase Auth & Firestore Security Rules.

Key Features
  • Task manager
  • Pomodoro focus timer
  • Google Calendar sync
  • AI flashcards
  • Shared study rooms
  • AI-powered insights
  • Mood & sleep tracking
  • AI meal planning
  • Meal logging
  • Guided relaxation
  • Role-based access

My Roledesigned and built the entire app solo — UI/UX, Flutter front-end, Firebase Authentication, and Firestore data modeling.

CivicNature — Report. Track. Improve.

Web Application
HTML5CSS3JAVASCRIPT

A civic reporting platform connecting residents of Sulaymaniyah with city management — photo uploads, an interactive map, community upvoting, and a species guide, with every report tracked Pending → In Progress → Resolved. Built entirely in vanilla JavaScript with no framework and no backend database, so all reporting logic and state runs client-side in the browser.

Key Features
  • Photo issue reporting
  • Interactive city map
  • Status tracking
  • Community upvoting
  • Local species guide
  • Filter by category & severity

My Roledesigned and built the entire platform solo — UX, front-end, and the full reporting/status workflow.

Key Features

  • Custom cake builder
  • Live order tracking
  • Loyalty rewards
  • AI-assisted chatbot

My Roledesigned the full UX/UI and visual direction, then built the mobile-first front end in HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

AI Coaching App

Mobile Applicationbuilding

Key Features

  • AI body scan
  • Interactive muscle map
  • AI-generated workout plans
  • AI meal planner
  • Weekly analysis

My Roledesigned the UI/UX and built the clickable prototype; the Flutter front end is in progress.
